entities.name: Perdiccas I of Macedon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Perdiccas I was king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon. By allowing thirty years for the span of an average generation from the beginning of Archelaus' reign in 413 BC, British historian Nicholas Hammond estimated that Perdiccas ruled around 653 BC.
